user.title: Configure Sonoff TRVZB Thermostats
user.description: Select the climate entities of your Sonoff TRVZB valves. The integration automatically discovers linked weekly_schedule text entities and TRVZB settings on each device.

data_description.climate_entities: Select one or more climate.* entities exposed by Zigbee2MQTT.
data_description.restore_delay: Recommended 0.25s to avoid overloading the Zigbee coordinator.
data_description.auto_safety_backup: Automatically saves live states into _last_before_restore before applying a profile.

error.no_climate_entities: Please select at least one climate entity.
error.no_schedule_entities: No weekly_schedule or TRVZB setting entities were found for the selected devices.

abort.already_configured: TRV Schedule Backup is already configured. Use Configure (Options) to edit thermostats.

init.title: Update TRVZB Thermostats & Pacing
init.description: Add or remove TRVZB climate entities, adjust Zigbee delay, or toggle automatic pre-restore safety snapshots.

error.no_climate_entities: Please select at least one climate entity.
error.no_schedule_entities: No weekly_schedule or TRVZB setting entities were found for the selected devices.

save_profile.name: Save backup profile
save_profile.description: Read current weekly schedules, TRVZB settings, and climate system modes from all or selected thermostats and save under a profile name.

profile_name.name: Profile name
profile_name.description: Unique identifier for the backup profile (e.g., heat_pump, solid_boiler).

entities.name: Target thermostats / entities
entities.description: Optional list of climate or device entities to back up. Leave empty for all configured thermostats.

parameters.name: Parameters to back up
parameters.description: Choose all (default), groups, or specific TRVZB parameters.

restore_profile.name: Restore backup profile
restore_profile.description: Restore all or selected thermostats and parameters sequentially with optional delta filtering, safety backup, and readback verification.

profile_name.name: Profile name
profile_name.description: Name of the previously saved profile to restore.

entities.name: Thermostats / entities to restore
entities.description: Optional list of entities stored in the backup. Leave empty to restore all devices in this profile.

parameters.name: Parameters to restore
parameters.description: Select all (default), groups, or individual TRVZB parameters. system_mode is applied last.

delta_only.name: Delta restore only
delta_only.description: Skip writing entities whose live state already matches the saved backup value.

safety_backup.name: Pre-restore safety snapshot
safety_backup.description: Override integration option to save _last_before_restore before applying changes.

verify.name: Verify restored parameters
verify.description: Wait briefly after writing and log any mismatches in last_restore_result without retrying.

diff_profile.name: Compare profile with current state
diff_profile.description: Return a list of schedules and settings that differ between a saved backup profile and live thermostat states.

profile_name.name: Profile name
profile_name.description: Saved profile to compare against live states.

entities.name: Target thermostats / entities
entities.description: Optional filter of devices or entities to compare.

parameters.name: Parameters to compare
parameters.description: Optional filter of parameter groups or keys.

delete_profile.name: Delete backup profile
delete_profile.description: Permanently delete a saved backup profile from storage.

profile_name.name: Profile name
profile_name.description: Name of the profile to delete.

no_matching_entities.message: No matching TRVZB entities were found for the provided filter.

no_matching_parameters.message: No valid TRVZB parameters were selected.
